key_terms.جَنَّاتِ: Gardens (plural of Jannah, referring to Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What does 'Gardens of Tranquility' refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Gardens of Delight' (Jannat al-Na'im) is often interpreted as the ultimate station of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, representing the consummation of divine proximity and eternal joy. This phrase underscores the concept of 'Na'im' not merely as physical pleasure, but as the spiritual bliss of beholding the Divine Countenance, a key theme in the teachings of the Imams.
